rows.title: The Boy Who Watched the Sky
rows.characters: Aldric Vane, Maren Vane, Josse Vane, Daran, unnamed traveling mage (glimpsed), unnamed passing trader woman
rows.events: Morning errands in Ashford (root oil from Wyla, round bread); Aldric attempts mana hand-position from memory of harvest market mage; first mana pressure flicker (sternum, brief, under the kitchen table); afternoon practice session with Daran in the eastern field using Daran's pamphlet technique; second mana pressure flicker during field practice ("There" — immediately suppressed and denied to Daran); both boys observe a traveling mage-figure on the south road; Daran declares "We'll both get in"
rows.stateChanges: Aldric: two uncontrolled mana pressure flickers experienced and concealed; Daran: acquired foundational positioning pamphlet (cost: one week's lunch); both boys' ambition to reach the academy made explicit; traveling mage sighting crystallizes the aspiration
rows.hookActivity: H-01 opened (mana pressure sensation, unexplained); H-02 opened (Daran's "we'll both get in" promise, future-broken)
rows.mood: Warm, intimate, quietly elegiac — the last good afternoon before the world changes

rows.title: What the Village Knows
rows.characters: Aldric Vane, Maren Vane, Josse Vane, Daran
rows.events: Morning herb-bundling in Maren's workroom; unnamed neighbour woman treated for wrist injury (Aldric observes Maren's healer manner); Maren explicitly tells Aldric he will get into the academy and that she will miss him; Josse returns from the Harrel job, asks about practice, delivers the line "you'll know when it changes — because you won't be able to set it aside"; Daran arrives mid-thought with pamphlet diagram dispute (left-hand index finger alignment); fence-sitting conversation; Daran reveals his father spoke to the spring assessor and suggests Aldric request a preliminary review; Daran shares firestone candy without being asked; Daran departs; Aldric sits on back step listening to village evening sounds; sustained pressure event in bed at night — longer and more body-wide than Ch. 1 flickers; Aldric sets it aside and sleeps
rows.stateChanges: Aldric: third mana pressure event experienced (sustained, body-wide, private, unwitnessed — longer than Ch. 1 flickers); pressure is developing in duration and scope; Maren's certainty about academy acceptance now explicit; Josse's cryptic observation about "not being able to set it aside" planted; spring assessor preliminary review introduced as near-future milestone; no witness event occurred (chapter memo's shimmer/witness beat not executed — carry to Ch. 3)
rows.hookActivity: H-01 advanced (pressure event longer and more developed, still private); H-02 deferred (Daran present but promise undisturbed); H-03 opened (Josse's precise phrasing raises question of what he knows); H-04 opened (Maren's unqualified certainty raises same question)
rows.mood: Warm, domestic, quietly accumulating — the village in its ordinary rhythms while something underneath begins to build

rows.title: What the Instrument Sees
rows.events: Spring preliminary assessment at guild hall: written component (40 questions, F-to-S rank criteria, mana channel theory); Daran assessed first (11 minutes, composed result); Aldric assessed alone — assessor checks instrument a second time, recalibrates rod, makes a note, gives no explanation; formal exam correspondence confirmed (6–8 weeks, kingdom channel, Vane household); boys walk home on south road discussing exam structure (Ren Dallus's brother, combat weighting); village feels like something about to end; dinner ordinary (Josse asks, Aldric says preliminary); night pressure event — fourth total, fingers curl and release without volition (first motor manifestation); Aldric connects assessor's double-check to involuntary movement and files both away
rows.stateChanges: Aldric: attended preliminary assessment; anomaly externally witnessed by assessor for first time; formal exam registered; fourth pressure event with first involuntary motor manifestation (fingers); Aldric-Daran parity has hairline fracture (assessor's differential reaction felt, not named); village-as-home beginning to feel finite
rows.hookActivity: H-01 advanced to pressured (assessor witnesses anomaly; involuntary movement escalates pressure events); H-02 deferred (parity cracked but promise not invoked); H-03 deferred (Josse at dinner, no explanation); H-04 deferred (Maren silent); H-05 opened (assessor's note — content withheld); H-06 opened (involuntary finger movement — first motor manifestation)
rows.mood: Quiet, accumulating unease — the village in its last ordinary rhythms while the instrument has already seen something neither boy can name
